name: C1 photoreceptor -> descending neuron propagation
criterion: driving all R1-6 photoreceptors at 100 Hz activates >1% of descending neurons in the pure LIF connectome (expected to FAIL: early fly vision is graded, which is why flydoom injects vision at the visual projection neurons)

name: C2 lateralised visuomotor pathway
criterion: LC/LPLC drive in the left eye pushes DNa02 (ipsilateral steering) activity to the left more than right-eye drive does

name: C3 looming -> giant fibre
criterion: driving looming detectors LC4 + LPLC2 makes the giant fibre (DNp01) fire > 20 Hz from silence
